newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's August gold output rises 22.6 percent.
newsitem.headline: Peru's August gold output rises 22.6 percent.

text.p: Peru's gold output rose 22.6 percent to six tonnes in August, compared with the same month last year, according to preliminary figures from the Energy and Mines Ministry released Friday.
Production rose 18.1 percent to 43.9 tonnes in the first eight months of the year compared with the same period last year, the ministry said.

Peru is Latin America's second largest gold producer after Brazil and the 12th largest in the world. The country's largest gold producer is Minera Yanacocha S.A., a joint venture operated by U.S.-based Newmont Mining Co..
The ministry's figures include 1994 estimates for output by Peru's informal gold miners who account for about 40 percent of national output.
